selected_evidence.requirement: 100 MB filesystem quota for datauser under /srv/data
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the dedicated ext4 mount, active user quotas, and 102400 KiB soft and hard limits for datauser.
Before and after reboot, a 110 MB write failed at approximately 100 MB with `Disk quota exceeded`; test files were cleaned up.
Captures the healthy baseline and original boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered mount/quota/account, matching marker checksum, and final healthy system state.
The quota-enabled mount is active, the marker checksum is intact, system state is running, and there are zero failed units.
